nuevos.descripcion:
Jak nabrat svaly a zvýšit sílu? Musíte cvičit do selhání, dodržovat přesně 8–12 opakování a chodit do posilovny skoro každý den? Nebo mohou stačit dva kvalitní tréninky týdně?

Cvičím přes 20 let. V tomhle videu propojuji svoje zkušenosti z praxe s vědeckými poznatky o silovém tréninku, růstu svalů a regeneraci. Ukážu vám, na čem skutečně záleží a které detaily si ve fitness zbytečně komplikujeme.

Vycházím také z nových doporučení American College of Sports Medicine (ACSM) z roku 2026, která shrnují 137 systematických přehledů a data od více než 30 000 lidí.

Ve videu se dozvíte:

💪 Jak se liší trénink pro růst svalů a maximální sílu
🏋️ Kolik opakování dělat a jak těžké váhy používat
🔥 Jestli musíte cvičit do svalového selhání a jak pracovat s rezervou opakování (RIR)
📊 Kolik sérií týdně potřebujete a kdy už více nemusí být lépe
📅 Kolikrát týdně cvičit a jak vybírat mezi full body a děleným tréninkem
⏱️ Jak dlouhé mají být pauzy mezi sériemi

Na závěr všechno spojím do praktického příkladu: jak bych dnes začínal s posilováním, kdybych chtěl nabrat svalovou hmotu, zesílit a sestavit si dlouhodobě udržitelný tréninkový plán.

Síla a svaly pro mě nejsou jen otázkou vzhledu. Jsou také fyzickou rezervou, kterou si budujeme pro zdraví, soběstačnost a dlouhověkost.

nuevos.descripcion:
Brigham Buhler submitted 17 FOIA requests to the FDA after they banned peptides, then testified before an FDA committee armed with over 800 studies and 5,000 pages of documents — including a retrospective analysis of 14 million patients that turned up just 3 adverse events. The FDA never publicly released any of it.

Brigham is the founder of Ways2Well clinic in Austin and ReviveRx, a cash-pay compounding pharmacy in Houston. He has spent years inside the insurance and pharmacy benefit manager system, and what he found — hidden rebates, deliberate dosage stair-stepping, and a financial structure that profits from sicker patients — drives everything he does now.

In this conversation, Brigham and Dr. Axe walk through how pharmacy benefit managers actually work, why GLP-1 drugs were pushed to the highest doses, what therapeutic plasma exchange and EBOO ozone therapy are doing for patients, the real safety record of peptides like BPC-157, and what Eli Lilly's push to reclassify its next blockbuster drug as a biologic would mean for patient access to affordable care.

outliers.descripcion:
Do you wake up exhausted, crash at 3 PM, then lie awake at night? Dr. Josh Axe explores how stress and disrupted cortisol rhythms may affect energy, sleep, belly fat, blood sugar, and hormones.

He breaks down seven strategies to support a healthier cortisol rhythm, ranks their impact, and discusses herbs studied for stress support. He also shares the weekly habit he values more than any supplement.

From morning sunlight and a balanced breakfast to breathing exercises and a consistent bedtime, the episode focuses on daily habits you can build into your routine. Dr. Axe explains his evidence and impact scores for each strategy, why sleep tops his list, and how he combines these practices throughout the day.

outliers.titulo_original: How Betrayal, Divorce & Trauma Wrecked Her Body — And How She Healed
outliers.descripcion:
The night before her oldest daughter's rehearsal dinner, Lysa TerKeurst discovered her husband of over two decades had been living a double life. She kept it secret from nearly everyone — and within months, the physical toll became impossible to hide. She collapsed getting out of bed, was rushed to the emergency room, and surgeons removed a significant portion of her colon. When the doctor showed her a picture and asked what had happened to her body, she told him everything was fine.

One year later, almost to the day, she heard the words: you have breast cancer.

In this conversation, Lysa and Dr. Axe talk through how unprocessed emotional trauma shows up in the body, why keeping pain locked inside accelerates physical illness, and what it actually takes to heal — including how to identify the lies you've built your life around, why forgiveness is something you do for yourself, how to set boundaries without pushing people away, and the difference between stewarding your life and trying to control it.

About Lysa TerKeurst:

Lysa TerKeurst is a New York Times bestselling author and the founder of Proverbs 31 Ministries. After enduring the discovery of her then-husband's double life, two major abdominal surgeries, and a breast cancer diagnosis, she has devoted her work to helping people heal emotionally and spiritually. Her latest book is *Making Peace with What I Can't Control*.
